timing_definition: Launch wall time includes Python/process startup and all repeat phases through workflow completion; excludes earlier acquisition/native fitting/preparation/freeze and later scientific closeout.
limits: All full campaigns are new inputs without saved stock repeats for the identical frozen plans; no measured twenty-repeat stock/engine speedup ratio is available.
Results were measured on the active production machine and are not controlled idle-machine benchmarks.
Worker CPU seconds per elapsed second is observed CPU use, not a counterfactual speedup.
The 21 first-two futility exits retain the scientific allocation rule; they are not twenty-repeat timings.
Hash and normalization checks establish record integrity and arithmetic consistency, not physical validation.
